status: design vectors; not an executable or passing product test suite
policyStatus: synthetic proposed bounds; real source cadence and routing uncertainty policy remain unapproved/unmeasured
fixtureRules: All identifiers, coordinates, times and route bounds are synthetic; no real person or route is represented.

Each event starts from the base fixture below, with observedAt/collectedAt/route completion equal to event.at, and new fix IDs based on event sequence. JSON nested overrides merge; null endpoint/route means missing. Expected notifications are literal, never computed by the evaluator.

fixPairID repeats both fix identities even if collection times change: it is a producer replay and cannot advance close dwell. friendFixID alone repeats only the friend fix while the user has a fresh changed fix; this permits reevaluation when self moves.

city is a separate existing city-check observation, default nearby with a distinct check ID for every event. The existing city watch remains the regression control. restartBefore round-trips persisted state before that event.
Route interval bounds stand for a hypothetical evidence-backed test provider, not bounds returned by MapKit or derived from coordinate distance.
